evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic warning framing carries urgency-as-alarm: an unrehearsed rollback is declared equivalent to no rollback at all, high-arousal negative valence in the directive's force.
Neutral, settled register recording a cadence decision — low arousal, positive valence of a satisfied scheduling note.
Flat attribution of ownership, same settled register as the cadence note — low arousal, mildly positive valence of a resolved assignment.
